quiz.question_pt: ¿Cómo se dice "Ella debe de haberlo olvidado" (deducción)?

options: I might have left it home.
I should have listened to you.
No puede ser que te hayas molestado.
No hacía falta que te molestaras.

data_es.tip_pt: Al hablar, "should have" se reduce a "should've" (suena como "shoulda"). Nunca escribas "should of": lo correcto siempre es have + participio.

items.en: I should have listened to you.
We ought to have left earlier.

exercises.sentence: You should have ___ me you were coming.
She must have ___ the train; she's not here yet.
I wouldn't have ___ that if I'd known.
They might have ___ stuck in traffic.

data_es.summary_pt: Usa modal + have + participio para hablar de arrepentimientos, deducciones y posibilidades en el pasado.
data_es.cover_prompt: A cute hand-drawn person looking back thoughtfully at a winding path behind them, with a small clock running backwards and a thought bubble with a question mark shape, soft pastel colors, no text or letters

common_mistake.right: I should have gone to the doctor.
common_mistake.wrong: I must have gone to the doctor.
common_mistake.why_pt: "Must have" es deducción; para arrepentimiento ("debí") usa "should have".
